COLLEEN ASKVIG

Organizational leader and attorney who drives change to deliver compliance, growth, productivity and employee engagement while improving the overall customer experience.  

Skilled in compliance, legal, operations, client relations, quality improvement, process re-engineering across business areas, vendor management, merger and acquisition transition and integration of process, policy and people.  

Expertise includes:  Building high-performance work teams, implementation of standardized processes, maximizing company value, driving operational excellence, while ensuring regulatory compliance.

Developed and implemented claims processing systems to process 25,000 complex, legal claims a month. Also supported new product development. Member of the leadership team that established company strategy, and translated mission, vision and values into departmental goals. 

EMPLOYEE AND TALENT MANAGEMENT

Managed a team of up to 100 employees through 6 direct reports. Responsible for strategic staffing decisions, hiring and training processes resulting in high performing work teams.


PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION

Oversight of transaction processing and claim adjudication for multiple product lines. Responsible for the day-to-day oversight of the Operations program as well as Strategic planning, New business development and product implementation. Successfully represented organization in new business development and RFP presentations.

PROCESS IMPROVEMENT | QUALITY

Designed, tested, implemented and improved major technology initiatives using a work flow system that resulted in dramatic cost savings and improved quality. These initiatives were accomplished in a seamless fashion for the end user. Reduced processing lifecycle time by 
50 % (20 days) through standardizing processes and workflow systems.
